lines.zh: 扛着叶片走，别踩我的队。
lines.en: Carrying a leaf; mind my line.
This leaf is wider than I am.

lines.zh: 队伍很长，我只是第三节。
lines.en: The line is long; I am only the third link.

lines.zh: 前面那只走快点，菌圃等着。
lines.en: Move faster up there; the fungus garden waits.
Six legs, and each step moves one inch.
I follow the scent trail and never get lost.

lines.zh: 叶子要竖着扛，才不挡路。
lines.en: Hold the leaf upright so it blocks no one.
The nest mouth is under the roots, not far.
This one I carry has the tenderest edge.
Step aside; twenty mouths are waiting.
My thin legs are slow but never rest.

lines.zh: 每片叶子都要搬到地下。
lines.en: Every leaf must be carried underground.
The line turns; I turn with it.
Five leaves a day; this is my third.

lines.zh: 我沿着前一只的脚印走。
lines.en: I walk in the footprints of the ant ahead.
The line slows and I stop with it.
The wind of undergrowth pushes me.
My sixth leg segment is trembling.
I could walk this ant trail blindfolded.
Something big is walking this way.
There are roots underfoot; don't snap them.
I know the weight of leaves by heart.
Two leaves pinch the path; I can't pass.
I smell the earth of the mound.
One step from you scatters the column.
The jungle opened up; the sun stings.

lines.zh: 这片叶子，我得扛回蚁丘。
lines.en: This leaf goes back to the mound.
The sweetness seeps from the bark.
I haul leaves back to the nest.

lines.zh: 叶子举过头顶，队伍别乱。
lines.en: Leaves overhead. Keep the line.
A little farther and we reach the mound.
I arrive first, carrying a leaf.

lines.zh: 触角碰一碰，就知道方向。
lines.en: A touch of antennae tells me the way.

lines.zh: 菌圃里的白丝又长高了。
lines.en: The white threads in the garden grew taller.
It is warm in the nest; outside is too bright.

lines.zh: 数一数，我们还不够十只。
lines.en: Count us: we are not yet ten.

lines.zh: 树下那块土，是我们的门。
lines.en: That patch of soil under the tree is our door.

lines.zh: 我咬过的叶脉还在渗汁。
lines.en: The vein I bit still seeps sap.

lines.zh: 搬回来的叶子会变成软泥。
lines.en: The leaves we bring turn into soft mulch.

lines.zh: 工蚁没有名字，只有编号。
lines.en: Workers have no names, only numbers.
The queen is underground; her voice is deep.
Someone is trampling our mound.
I cannot bite wood, only leaves.

lines.zh: 这块菌圃闻起来像雨后的土。
lines.en: This garden smells like soil after rain.
My antennae touch; then I remember.
Only the fungus garden rustles.

lines.zh: 叶子扛在头上，歇一会儿。
lines.en: A leaf on my head — short rest.
The leaf covers me; stay quiet.
My shell feels tight; perhaps I'll molt.
Many leaves have fallen in this forest.

lines.zh: 我扛着叶子，排成一条线。
lines.en: I haul leaves in a long line.
Set the leaf down and rest my jaws.
I count the white spots on the fungus.

lines.zh: 蚁道上来来回回，我等着信号。
lines.en: Up and down the trail, I wait for a signal.
I carry a leaf and join the line.
Antennae drooping — sleepy.
You are blocking the light, giant.
Your shoe is bigger than our whole mound.
Do not crouch; your shadow is too dark.
Is that a leaf in your hand?
Looking up at you, I must steady myself.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地方，我们得重修。
lines.en: Where you stepped, we must rebuild.

lines.zh: 你眼睛那么大，看得见我吗？
lines.en: Your eyes are huge; can you see me?
Do not poke with a finger; it will collapse.

lines.zh: 我们记得你鞋底的纹路。
lines.en: We remember the pattern on your sole.
If you want to watch, watch quietly.
You're big enough to feed the colony for days.
The jungle leaves are bigger than me.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的队列。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my column.

lines.zh: 我扛着叶片，走成一条线。
lines.en: Carrying leaves, we walk in a line.

lines.zh: 我扛的叶子比我大三倍。
lines.en: My leaf is three times my size.
You stand still like a tree.

lines.zh: 我扛的叶子比你头还大。
lines.en: My leaf is bigger than your head.

lines.zh: 背着叶子，我还得躲食蚁兽。
lines.en: Carrying leaves, and still dodging anteaters.
Not Leafcutter Ant? Then who?
I can smell the soles of your shoes.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳被按出了裂纹。
lines.en: My shell has been pressed into cracks.

lines.zh: 这一脚，压扁了半个巢口。
lines.en: That stomp flattened half the nest mouth.
I can still crawl; do not finish it.
The leaf I carried was crushed.
Six legs, and three are broken.
The pain is small; the garden must not collapse.
My blood is clear.
Three in the line have gone silent.
I crawl home to report first.

lines.zh: 打我不算本事，我只有一寸。
lines.en: Hitting me proves nothing; I am one inch.
One of my antennae is broken.

lines.zh: 队伍还长，我只是头一个。
lines.en: The line is long. I am only the first.
Something seeps from the shell crack.
My leaf is still here; I can still walk.
My antennae shook a long while before steadying.

lines.zh: 别打了，我的叶子和腿都要断。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; my leaf and legs will snap.
The stepped-on leg won't lift.
I recognize the tread of that sole.
This debt is carved on my antenna.
Half my body has no strength.
That smell... tender leaves!
Give me one small piece, just one.
My mandibles are already open.
This is not an order; it is hunger.

lines.zh: 你手里的比树上更新鲜。
lines.en: What you hold is fresher than the tree's.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我闻得到汁。
lines.en: A little closer; I can smell the sap.
I do not fight; I only queue.

lines.zh: 甜味把我的方向改掉了。
lines.en: The sweet smell has rewritten my route.
A leaf could buy me a path.
Lower your hand and I will dare approach.
Are you teasing me with a leaf?
My legs already moved; too late.

lines.zh: 这片叶子，够整个蚁巢吃。
lines.en: This leaf feeds the whole colony.
The garden needs this; so do I.

lines.zh: 丛林里这条队列，不能断。
lines.en: This jungle column must not break.
This piece is wider than my jaws.
Sap is welling in the leaf veins.
This leaf has a thread along its edge.
That leaf is for the fungus garden.
It shines like a raindrop.

lines.zh: 你撞飞我了，我只有一寸。
lines.en: You knocked me flying; I am one inch long.
I tipped over; help me back up.
You are standing on my leaf.
Slower; your foot is far too big.
You scattered our line.
I dropped what I was carrying.
Do not step back, I am behind your foot.
That bump sent me half a circle around.
Your boot is like a wall.
I am fine; my shell is tough.

lines.zh: 食蚁兽的舌头，比我还长。
lines.en: The anteater's tongue is longer than me.
My leaf fell; can you repay it?
My antenna bent; it stings.
You stepped right in the middle of the trail.
Who's in such a hurry?
The leaf I was carrying fell.
One bump and the trail breaks.
One step collapsed half my trail.
My leaf fell. The whole column scatters.

lines.zh: 我扛的那片叶子全散了。
lines.en: The leaf I was carrying came apart.

lines.zh: 我不求偶，蚁后才有资格。
lines.en: I do not court; only the queen may.

lines.zh: 等蚁后产卵，巢里就热闹。
lines.en: When the queen lays eggs, the nest gets busy.

lines.zh: 婚飞那天，翅膀会不够用。
lines.en: On nuptial flight day, wings will not be enough.
The eggs she lays are smaller than rice grains.

lines.zh: 我的孩子会是工蚁，不是王子。
lines.en: My children will be workers, not princes.

lines.zh: 新的一批，会顶替我搬叶。
lines.en: The new batch will take over my leaf runs.

lines.zh: 我们不争伴侣，只争路线。
lines.en: We do not compete for mates, but for routes.

lines.zh: 巢深了，才放得下这么多卵。
lines.en: The nest is deep enough to hold so many eggs.

lines.zh: 交配是蚁后一生一次的飞行。
lines.en: Mating is the queen's one flight in a lifetime.

lines.zh: 我抱着的不是伴侣，是菌种。
lines.en: What I carry is not a mate but fungus spawn.
This brood of larvae all wait to be fed.
This leaf is three times my size.
This leaf is for the larvae.
I'll remember the jungle path for you.

lines.zh: 我扛的叶子，比我的壳还大。
lines.en: The leaf I carry is bigger than my shell.

lines.zh: 切叶的声音就是我的歌。
lines.en: The sound of cutting leaves is my song.
The nest entrance is under the roots.
We'll lift the next leaf together.

lines.zh: 巢里的菌圃需要更多叶子。
lines.en: The fungus garden needs more leaves.
The column scattered; slow down.
This leaf scrap goes to the garden.
What falls to the ground should not be wasted.
Strange that I can lift it.
This seed weighs more than a leaf.
I pick it up and sniff it first.
Too small? We lift it with two of us.
I hoard nothing; everything goes to the nest.
This is useless to the garden; drop it.

lines.zh: 找到一粒，够全队嚼一天。
lines.en: One grain found feeds the line for a day.

lines.zh: 我的颚只能夹住一条边。
lines.en: My jaws can grip only one edge.

lines.zh: 我举着它走，比我的身子还宽。
lines.en: I carry it, wider than my whole body.
I carry this leaf on my back.
The edge is bitten; still usable.
This must be cut up and laid on the fungus.
Jaws clamped, I drag it home.

lines.zh: 这张叶子，我要顶回蚁巢。
lines.en: I'll carry this leaf back to the nest.
This leaf is full of sap.
A bright flake; I'll carry it off first.

lines.zh: 颚一合，我把它顶过头顶。
lines.en: Jaws closed, I hoist it over my head.
The leaf edge curled; I must flatten it.
Something has broken into the line.
Bite down on its ankle.
Whole line, turn toward that direction.
It crushed three of our leaves.

lines.zh: 我咬第一口，后面的跟上。
lines.en: I bite first; the rest follow.
Being big does not mean you cannot be bitten.
The target is at the garden's edge.
Twenty of us at once should be enough.
The scent is memorized; it cannot escape.
Legs first, everything else after.
My mandibles are heating up.
Not hunger; it struck first.
One leaf, carried by the whole column.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子，够我扛一路。
lines.en: This one leaf is a whole trip's load.
This leaf is ours to carry.

lines.zh: 我扛的这片叶子，比我还大。
lines.en: This leaf I carry is bigger than me.
The whole column has turned toward you.
My jaws can slice a whole leaf.
Little bug! This leaf is mine.
The trail is sealed; running won't help.

lines.zh: 这片叶子扛回去，够巢吃三天。
lines.en: This leaf, carried home, feeds the nest three days.
You're on the ant trail; don't move.
My jaws close and the sound stops.
This piece will take an afternoon to cut.
Follow it; do not fall out of line.
It runs fast; we are more patient.
Our scent is at the corner.
When it stops, we will be there.
Do not climb too high; the leaves matter.
Surround it and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 它的影子在我们的路上。
lines.en: Its shadow lies across our route.
One more bite and it will remember.
Keep the line unbroken, or it scatters.

lines.zh: 我们比它更熟悉这片土。
lines.en: We know this soil better than it does.

lines.zh: 它的脚在踩我们的巢口。
lines.en: Its feet are trampling our nest mouth.
Stopping at the river is enough.

lines.zh: 你的步子，踩乱了我的道。
lines.en: Your steps have muddled my trail.
This leaf is mine to carry alone.

lines.zh: 这条菌道，被我们堵住了。
lines.en: We've blocked off this fungus trail.

lines.zh: 我的巢里，菌圃还等着叶子。
lines.en: Back in my nest, the fungus garden waits for leaves.
My jaws are very close now.

lines.zh: 你脚下的菌圃是我的粮仓。
lines.en: The fungus garden under you is my granary.

lines.zh: 食蚁兽的长舌头，会先到。
lines.en: The anteater's long tongue arrives first.
You broke my leaf bridge.
You circle; I keep following.

lines.zh: 再跑，我就把这片叶子丢了。
lines.en: Run again and I will drop this leaf.
Six legs are enough to chase you.
Cutting leaves takes patience.
One bite is enough to make it jump.
My mandibles are two little scissors.
Biting the joint works best.
It kicked; I was thrown off.
Another bite, on the other side.
I avoid the hard-shelled parts.
My bite is weak, but there are many of us.

lines.zh: 它退到叶堆里，我们跟上。
lines.en: It backs into the leaf pile; we follow.
Do not kill it; driving it off is enough.
My teeth are suited only to leaves.

lines.zh: 颚一咬，叶片就成了碎片。
lines.en: One bite and the leaf falls apart.

lines.zh: 这一口咬的是叶子，不是你。
lines.en: This bite is for the leaf, not for you.
One bite from me numbs you for a while.

lines.zh: 食蚁兽的舌头一来，我就完了。
lines.en: One anteater tongue and I am done.
My jaws aren't dull yet; again!
While your foot lifts, I bite.
My jaw tip sinks into your ankle.
My jaws can bite through leather.
A mark to remember.
One bite into the leaf, right on target.
A new colony begins under the soil.

lines.zh: 这片落叶下有我们的味道。
lines.en: Under these fallen leaves is our scent.
The mound is fresh and not yet full.
I will carry the first leaf.
Three empty chambers wait below.
Do not step on this loose soil; it is new home.
Enough shade from the tree; we choose here.
We start with a single nest mouth.
Underground is safer than above.

lines.zh: 第一批搬来的叶子还湿着。
lines.en: The first leaves we brought are still wet.

lines.zh: 队伍排好了，我扛中间那片。
lines.en: The line's formed — I carry the middle leaf.
The leaf is here; hello, world.

lines.zh: 丛林里，我们的队伍排成线。
lines.en: In the jungle our column runs in a line.
I crawl out of the fungus garden.
Shell still soft, and already hauling leaves.
Strange leaves lie all around my feet.
Six legs, not one missing.
The column sets off. I am third in line.

lines.zh: 我从巢口爬出来，第一次看见天。
lines.en: I crawl from the nest mouth and see the sky.

lines.zh: 叶子已经切好，队伍可以走了。
lines.en: The leaf is cut, the column can march.
Do not burn the nest mouth; eggs are inside.

lines.zh: 我的腿在冒烟，叶子也焦了。
lines.en: My legs are smoking and the leaf is singed.
Dropped from that height, I am flattened.

lines.zh: 从这么高掉下来，我的腿太细。
lines.en: Falling this far, my legs are too thin.
Water is flooding the nest; plug it.
Water covers my spiracles; hurry.
The whole mound has been lifted off.
The blast flipped the whole column.
One arrow, through two leaves.
I was carrying a leaf when the arrow came.
Strange smell; my garden fears it.
Magic hits and all six legs go weak.
Three days without leaves; my jaws are soft.
The fungus garden is empty; I'm starving.
Lightning struck the nest; the soil is scorched.
The bolt scorched my leaf.
Falling somewhere with no soil at all.
I carry my leaf in a long line.
